Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Francesca Schiavone Wikipedia page and incorrectly stated that Schiavone was runner-up at the 2011 Wimbledon, instead of the 2011 French Open. This misinterpretation could have led to identifying the wrong common Grand Slam (Wimbledon) rather than the correct one (French Open).
